sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We appreciate your willingness to adjust the payment terms to 14 days and extend the contract to 24 months.
For this package, we can offer a revised price of €4.87 per unit.
Regarding your mentioned volume of 20,000 pieces per year, could you please provide a firm release schedule or historical data to substantiate this?
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €4.87 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your revised offer for a 36-month agreement with 60-day payment terms. However, we are unable to reduce our price further and must maintain our offer of €4.91 per unit for this package. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. To proceed with the volume of 20,000 pieces per year, we still require a firm release schedule. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
